import ast,runpy,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
p=runpy.run_path("analysis/scripts/check_git_content.py")
assert p["MAX_BYTES"] == 25 * 1024 * 1024
ast.parse(Path("analysis/scripts/check_git_content.py").read_text())
yes=["comparisons_A.txt","mission_inputs.txt","output_groups.txt","frozen_identities.txt","source.md5","offset.csv","manifest.json","crate.dat","time_offset.cc"]
no=["data.root","data.bin","time_offset","time_offset.o","auth.json","secrets.txt","secrets.md5","credentials.txt","credentials.md5",".env",".env.local","build/manifest.txt"]
for prefix in ("time_offset/", "time_offset/results/frozen/"):
 for names,expected in ((yes,True),(no,False)):
  for name in names:
   path=prefix+name
   assert p["permitted"](path) == expected, (path,"permitted")
   r=subprocess.run(["git","check-ignore","--no-index","-v",path],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True)
   assert r.returncode in (0,1), (path,r.stderr)
   pattern=r.stdout.split("\t",1)[0].split(":",2)[-1] if r.stdout else ""
   ignored=bool(pattern and not pattern.startswith("!"))
   assert ignored == (not expected), (path,pattern)
assert not p["permitted"]("elsewhere/metadata.txt")
assert not p["permitted"]("elsewhere/source.md5")
subprocess.run(["git","diff","--check"],check=True)
print("PASS: 42 path cases, effective Git ignore patterns, out-of-scope suffixes, 25 MiB limit, Python syntax, diff whitespace")

assert p["permitted"]("LICENSE")
subprocess.run(["python3","-B","analysis/scripts/check_git_content.py"],check=True)
print("PASS: existing LICENSE and full index content check")
